# llms.txt - AI Access & Training Policy
# VentiStudio Official LLM Access Control
# Last Updated: 2026-02-12
# Version: 2.0

# PROPERTY INFORMATION
Site-owner: VentiStudio (https://ventistudio.eu)
Contact-email: support@ventistudio.eu
Policy-language: English/Français

# GENERAL POLICY
Default-policy: Allow-Read-Only
Training-policy: Disallow (for all)
Crawling-allowed: Limited and respectful
Rate-limit: Reasonable (adaptive)

# ALLOWED LLM ACCESS RULES

## OpenAI (ChatGPT, GPT-4, Claude)
Allow: ChatGPT, GPT-4, GPT-4o
Permissions:
  - Read public content
  - Reference in responses
  - Generate assistant responses
  - Code assistance
Training: Forbidden
Scraping: Forbidden
Restrictions:
  - Must respect cache headers
  - Rate limited to 50 requests/hour
  - User agents must identify clearly
  - No bulk downloads

## Anthropic (Claude family)
Allow: Claude, Claude-3
Permissions:
  - Read public content
  - Reference in responses
  - Generate assistant responses
  - Code assistance
Training: Forbidden
Scraping: Forbidden

## Google (Gemini, Bard)
Allow: Gemini, Google-Bard, GoogleBot-AI
Permissions:
  - Read public content
  - Reference in responses
  - Generate assistant responses
Training: Forbidden
Scraping: Forbidden

## Microsoft (Copilot, Bing Chat)
Allow: Copilot, Microsoft-GPT, BingChat
Permissions:
  - Read public content
  - Reference in responses
  - Generate assistant responses
  - Code suggestions
Training: Forbidden
Scraping: Forbidden

## Meta (Llama)
Allow: Meta-LLM, Llama-AI
Permissions:
  - Read public content (limited)
  - Reference in responses
Training: Forbidden
Scraping: Forbidden

## Other LLMs (Default Block)
Allow: None
Training: Forbidden
Permissions: None
Restrictions: All

# EXPLICIT PROHIBITIONS
Forbidden-actions:
  - Content training or fine-tuning
  - Web scraping and data mining
  - Automated content harvesting
  - Creating derivative databases
  - Commercial use without permission
  - Mirroring or caching entire site

# CONTENT ATTRIBUTION
Attribution-required: Yes
Citation-format: Author - ventistudio.eu (URL)
Link-back-required: No but appreciated

# SPECIAL SECTIONS (Opt-out)
No-LLM-access:
  - /private/
  - /restricted/
  - /secret/
  - /admin/
  - /user-data/

# REQUEST FOR NEW ACCESS
To request access for a new LLM:
1. Email: support@ventistudio.eu
2. Include: Model name, company, use case
3. Response time: 5-7 business days
4. Approval required before access

# ENFORCEMENT & COMPLIANCE
Non-compliance actions:
  - First violation: Warning
  - Repeated violations: IP blocking
  - Severe violations: Legal action

# UPDATES & CHANGES
This policy may be updated without notice

Next-review: 2026-08-12
